summary: Cloudflare R2 image upload integration testing. All 12 R2 tests in test_r2_upload_iter87.py pass (12/12). Frontend loads correctly with login screen visible. Regression check: 36/37 old tests pass — 1 pre-existing test (test_image_upload_iter11.py::test_upload_image_url_contains_api_uploads) now fails because it expects the old /api/uploads/ URL pattern which is superseded by R2 URLs (https://images.winek.app/...). This is an expected intentional regression from the R2 migration.

minor.issue: test_image_upload_iter11.py::TestUploadImage::test_upload_image_url_contains_api_uploads now fails — old test asserts '/api/uploads/' in URL but R2 now returns 'https://images.winek.app/...' URLs. Not a bug — test is outdated and was written for the old filesystem fallback behavior. The new test_r2_upload_iter87.py covers this correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update test_image_upload_iter11.py::test_upload_image_url_contains_api_uploads to accept both R2 URLs (https://images.winek.app/...) and local fallback URLs (/api/uploads/) — or skip if the filesystem fallback is no longer expected in production.
MINOR: A warning appears at startup: No route named 'coach/[id]' exists — this is a missing route for coach profile navigation, unrelated to R2.
critical_code_review_comments: r2_storage.py: Correct implementation — compress_image() handles JPEG, PNG RGBA→WebP, WebP, GIF (passthrough), HEIC (via pillow_heif). Resize to max 2000px with LANCZOS. upload_to_r2() uses uuid hex[:16] for filenames to avoid collisions. delete_from_r2() gracefully handles NoSuchKey/404.

upload_routes.py: Correct security: JWT auth required [SEC-07], 5MB limit enforced via read(MAX+1) pattern [SEC-08], magic bytes validation (not Content-Type trust) [SEC-09], path traversal protection for local fallback [SEC-10]. Category validation via _ALLOWED_CATEGORIES set with 'other' fallback.

Frontend (create-service.tsx, create.tsx, edit-profile.tsx, user/[id].tsx): All upload calls correctly use ?category=services, ?category=spotyou, ?category=profiles respectively. Web and Native paths both implemented correctly. Base64 migration to R2 URL complete in edit-profile.tsx.

success_rate.backend: 97% (48/49 tests: 12/12 R2 + 36/37 old; 1 outdated test expected to fail)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — login screen loads correctly, no critical errors

seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo users. One service TEST_R2_Delete Service created and cleaned up during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R2 upload fully tested and working. test_r2_upload_iter87.py 12/12 PASS. Categories services/profiles/spotyou/other all return https://images.winek.app/{category}/img_*.{ext} URLs. PNG RGBA→WebP conversion works. JPEG 2500x2000 compression works. Auth (401), non-image (415), oversized (413) error codes all correct. Frontend login screen loads. The only issue is the outdated test_image_upload_iter11.py which expected /api/uploads/ URLs. R2 credentials are real and working in backend/.env.
rca_of_issue: test_image_upload_iter11.py::test_upload_image_url_contains_api_uploads: Written in iteration 11 to verify filesystem upload (local fallback). Now that R2 is configured and working, all uploads go to R2 (https://images.winek.app/...) instead of the local filesystem. The test checks for /api/uploads/ which is only used as a fallback when R2 is not configured. Fix: update assertion to check for either R2 URL or local URL pattern: assert 'images.winek.app' in url or '/api/uploads/' in url
